title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 05:34:38 最新章节：第292章 从未用过的底牌
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
看着手里的鸡血石砚台，顾铮嘴角的勾起一丝笑意，区区一百两银子能买到这么好的石头，赚大了！
他这大半个月拼命补这方面的知识，一块石头好不好还是能够看得出来的。
手里这块昌化鸡血石血色上上佳，属于大红袍级别，重量约莫有五百克，而且工艺鬼斧神工，肯定是大师手笔，至少能卖五六百万。
而他仅仅付出了一百两银子。
这是他来到这个世界的二十天，在他脑海中，悬浮在空空荡荡的空间中有一张铜镜。
铜镜颜色古朴，看起来平平无奇，在意识空间中起伏不定，散发出微微的豪光。
这铜镜的功能太变态了，竟然可以让他自由穿越于古代和现代世界，并且可以随时穿梭。
没有任何条件，肉身穿越，可以携带东西。
于是他就做起了两界倒爷，现代随便什么商品在古代都能卖出高价，比如镜子，比如人造宝石，现代工艺品……现代的很多商品在古代世界都是很稀有，珍贵的东西。
古代，也有一些东西在现代特别值钱。
比如书画古董，鸡血石，田黄，在现代都能卖出一个远比古代高的多价格。
短短半个月，他一个刚刚踏出校门的社会打工人就拥有了数百万的身家，在古代，他已经有了一间三进三出的宅院。
按照这个速度，即便他尽量低调，一年赚一个小目标都不难。
就比如他手里的这块昌化鸡血石砚台，至少能让他赚五六百万。
忽然，一阵喧嚣的市井吵闹声顿时涌入耳朵，顾铮愕然抬头。
这是一条古朴的长街，已经入夜，玉兔悬挂中天，街道两侧挂着白灯笼，光芒照耀，能见度也算不低。
长街之上人潮涌动，摩肩擦踵，只是街道上萦绕着些许的雾气，所以虽然在灯光的照耀之下，但离得远了点的人面貌就有些看不清了。
行人人来人往，仿佛从虚无中走来，又走入虚无。
“嗯？我怎么不记得回去的路上有这样一条路？”顾铮微微皱眉，但摸了摸身上的装备微微松了口气。
他身上穿着一件防弹衣，内置防弹钢板，至少能够抵御手枪的近距离射击，冷兵器更是不可能穿透防弹衣。

再加上一把匕首和一根电棍，电量大到轻易可以把人电晕。
“卖糖葫芦了！”一个穿着短衫的汉子扛着稻草杆子在街边吆喝。
“今天新砍的柴火！”一个妇人蹲在街边叫喊。
“又香又便宜的饼子！”
穿着各异的行人从顾铮身边走过，他摇摇头，准备快步离开。
忽然，一个男子拦在他面前，笑道：“客人，饿了么？来一碗羊杂汤么？”
顾铮这才身边有一个小摊，正要拒绝，一股从未闻过的香味从鼻孔中钻进来，惹得肚中的馋虫抗议，瞬间就咕咕叫起来。
“那就给我来一碗吧。”
拒绝的话到了嘴边换成了这句话，等回过神来，已经坐到了桌子旁边。
不多时，男子便端着一碗热腾腾的羊杂汤放到他面前。
汤底是黄色的，，撒上葱花，清香扑鼻，顾铮忍不住咽了咽口水，恨不得将这碗羊杂汤直接倒进口中。
他迫不及待取了筷子，拨弄了两下就要入口。
这时候，旁边传来一道嘶哑的声音，就仿佛是一条蛇在说话，顾铮循声望去，只见一个干瘦的人皱眉道：“老板，你的羊杂汤现在怎么这么淡了？”
小摊老板点头哈腰道：“稍等，客人我给你重新做一碗面。”
说着，小摊老板从旁边的箩筐里提起一个东西，那居然是一颗头。
看到羊杂汤摊老板的动作，顾铮眼睛瞪的圆圆的，好悬没叫出声来。
他伸长脑袋一看，锅里还有几个骷髅头。
content_en:
Looking at the chicken blood stone inkstone in his hand, Gu Zheng raised a smile. He could buy such a good stone for only a hundred taels of silver. He made a lot of money!
He has been working hard to improve his knowledge in this area for more than half a month, and he can still tell whether a stone is good or not.
The Changhua chicken blood stone in my hand has a very good color and belongs to the Dahongpao level. It weighs about 500 grams, and the craftsmanship is amazing. It must be the handiwork of a master. It can be sold for at least 5 to 6 million.
And he only paid one hundred taels of silver.
It was twenty days since he came to this world. In his mind, there was a bronze mirror suspended in the empty space.
The bronze mirror is simple in color and looks unremarkable. It fluctuates in the space of consciousness and emits a faint light.
The function of this bronze mirror is so abnormal that it allows him to travel freely between the ancient and modern worlds, and can travel back and forth at any time.
There are no conditions, the physical body can travel through, and you can carry things.
So he started to be a bad guy in both worlds. Any modern product could be sold at a high price in ancient times, such as mirrors, artificial gems, modern handicrafts... Many modern products were very rare and precious things in the ancient world.
In ancient times, there were some things that were particularly valuable in modern times.
For example, calligraphy and painting antiques, chicken blood stone, and Tianhuang can all be sold for a much higher price in modern times than in ancient times.
In just half a month, a migrant worker who had just stepped out of school had a net worth of millions. In ancient times, he already had a house with three entrances and three exits.
At this rate, even if he tries to keep a low profile, it will not be difficult to earn a small target a year.
For example, the Changhua chicken blood stone inkstone in his hand can earn him at least five to six million.
Suddenly, a burst of noisy noise from the market suddenly flooded into his ears, and Gu Zheng looked up in shock.
This is a quaint long street. It's already dark, the Jade Rabbit hangs in the sky, white lanterns hang on both sides of the street, the light shines, and the visibility is not low.
There were crowds of people on the long street, rubbing shoulders with each other, but there was a little fog lingering on the street, so although under the illumination of the lights, the faces of people who were farther away were somewhat unclear.
Pedestrians come and go, as if walking from nothingness and into nothingness.
"Huh? Why don't I remember that there is such a road on the way back?" Gu Zheng frowned slightly, but touched the equipment on his body and breathed a sigh of relief.
He was wearing a bulletproof vest with built-in bulletproof steel plates, which could at least withstand close range shots from pistols, and it was impossible for cold weapons to penetrate the bulletproof vest.
Coupled with a dagger and an electric baton, the electricity is powerful enough to easily stun people.
"Tanghulu is on sale!" A man in a short shirt shouted on the street carrying a straw pole.
"New firewood cut today!" A woman squatted on the street and shouted.
“Tasty and cheap pancakes!”
Pedestrians dressed in different styles walked past Gu Zheng. He shook his head and prepared to leave quickly.
Suddenly, a man stopped in front of him and said with a smile: "Guest, are you hungry? Would you like a bowl of haggis soup?"
Gu Zheng then saw a stall next to him, and just as he was about to refuse, a scent that he had never smelled entered his nostrils, causing the glutton in his stomach to protest, and he immediately began to growl.
"Then bring me a bowl."
The words of rejection were replaced by these words. When he came to his senses, he was already sitting at the table.
Not long after, the man placed a bowl of hot haggis soup in front of him.
The soup base was yellow, sprinkled with chopped green onion, and fragrant. Gu Zheng couldn't help but swallowed, and wanted to pour the bowl of mutton soup directly into his mouth.
He couldn't wait to take the chopsticks, fiddled with them twice before entering.
At this time, a hoarse voice came from the side, as if it was a snake talking. Gu Zheng followed the sound and saw a skinny man frowning and saying: "Boss, why is your haggis soup so weak now?"
The stall owner nodded and bowed: "Wait a moment, I'll give it to you as a guest."Make a new bowl of noodles. "
As he spoke, the stall owner picked up something from the basket next to him, and it turned out to be a head.
Seeing the actions of the owner of the haggis soup stall, Gu Zheng's eyes widened and he almost didn't scream.
He stretched his head and saw that there were several skulls in the pot.
